name: BRAND TEXT
description:
The SaunaMed company prides itself on being able to produce infrared sauna suits that combine advanced technology and practicality. The Durawave™ ceramic heater will heat the sauna cabin in only 5 minutes and the technology ensures fresh air circulation from the moment you switch on the sauna. SaunaMed saunas are cost effective, can be installed in under 30 minutes and are easy to move around the house.



The extra technology used in SaunaMed infrared saunas is also of a superior standard. The easy to use state of the art control panels are found on internal and external panels with an easy to find power switch. A radio, CD player, MPS / Ipod dock are all fitted as standard ensuring you can enjoy your own choice of music while relaxing and gaining the health benefits and weight loss of your infrared sauna



As each SaunaMed sauna undergoes extensive factory testing before it is shipped to the buyer these saunas are durable and faults are rarely reported. However, if you do encounter a fault, Infrared Sauna Parts stock SaunaMed replacement parts. They are light and easy to ship so please contact us for further information.
